unit: Algebra · Chapter 5. Continuity and the derivative
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: The derivative of f at x is f'(x) = lim (f(x + Δx) − f(x))/Δx as Δx → 0; finding it is called differentiation.
stages.headlineEnglish: The derivative of f at x is f'(x) = lim (f(x + Δx) − f(x))/Δx as Δx → 0; finding it is called differentiation.

stages.headline: Example: f(x) = x² gives Δf/Δx = 2x + Δx → 2x; also (C)' = 0 and (kx + b)' = k.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: f(x) = x² gives Δf/Δx = 2x + Δx → 2x; also (C)' = 0 and (kx + b)' = k.

stages.headline: Mechanically the derivative is velocity, v(t) = s'(t); geometrically it is the slope of the tangent to the graph.
stages.headlineEnglish: Mechanically the derivative is velocity, v(t) = s'(t); geometrically it is the slope of the tangent to the graph.
